lines: [tense] Gym mein jawan log achanak gir rahe hain. Aur report? Aksar normal.
[intrigued] Teen sau mein se ek jawan ke dil mein chhupi bimari hai.
[explaining] Wajah: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy — dil ki muscle bahut moti.
[serious] Exercise ka adrenaline aate hi wiring short — rhythm bigadta hai, pump band.
[grave] Warning do: exercise ke dauran behoshi. Aur ghar mein pachaas se pehle achanak maut.
[confident] Ek bhi haan? Do test — ECG aur ECHO.
[warm] Main Abhigyan Jain, MBBS student. Educational only.
